subject: Request: custom uptime & latency annex (order form + MSA/SOW attachments) — MedAlign
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@medalign.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medalign.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: custom uptime & latency annex (order form + MSA/SOW attachments) — MedAlign

Amit / Lena —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Per our discussion, attaching a first-pass SLA addendum and an annotated order form for MedAlign's enterprise MSA/SOW. The addendum focuses on two items you flagged: (1) a higher-availability commitment for the primary inference endpoint and (2) a defined latency tier for peak clinical queries.

Quick summary of what we’ve proposed in the attached redline:
- Uptime: 99.95% monthly availability for the primary inference endpoint (regional), with a 30-minute scheduled maintenance window per 30-day period excluded from uptime calculations; emergency maintenance still counted unless pre-notified.
- Latency: p99 generation latency SLA for payloads with <1k tokens (edge egress), measured at Redwood egress. Cold-starts (first request after a >60s idle) excluded from SLA.
- Credits: a graduated credit schedule capped at 30% of the monthly invoice for availability breaches.
- Evidence: monthly token-level latency & cost breakdown, and a runbook with telemetry access for audit (read-only dashboards + weekly snapshots).

Ask: can you confirm (a) whether MedAlign needs p99 or p95 for the clinical inference path, (b) whether the proposed credit cap aligns with procurement expectations, and (c) if you need SOC2/TLS attestations included in the addendum?

I’ve included a short evidence-matrix template and the annotated order form for legal review. If procurement prefers, we can convert the redline to Markup track changes in Word.

Doc links & attachments: MedAlign_Redline_OrderForm_20280815.pdf (redline), SLA_Addendum_Draft_20280815.docx, evidence-matrix-template.csv

Next steps: if we get confirmation on the three bullets above, I’ll loop in Legal (Kimberly) and CS (Stephanie) to finalize the runbook/evidence access. We can route final via DocuSign once signatures are agreed.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@medalign.com>

Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medalign.com>, procurement@medalign.com
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: custom uptime & latency annex (order form + MSA/SOW attachments) — MedAlign

Rishi —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the redlines. A few follow-ups from procurement and platform engineering:

1) Latency tier: for the clinical decisioning path we need a p99 SLA (not p95). For bulk batch jobs (nightly inference), p95 is okay. Can you confirm p99 definition and where it’s measured? Is it at your edge, or measured after our gateway?

2) Maintenance windows: our security team will not accept a rolling 30-minute maintenance allowance that can occur during peak hours. We need either a maintenance blackout during 08:00–20:00 ET (no scheduled maintenance in that window) or a guaranteed advance notice of 72 hours.

3) Credit cap: procurement asks that credits not be capped at >20% of the monthly invoice. They're also requesting a two-tier escalation path before credits are applied (operational remediation + 7-day technical fix period).

4) Evidence: we need at minimum monthly p99/p95 histograms and a 30-day raw sample of request traces for audited incidents (redacted). SOC2 cert is required to attach to the SOW.

Could Kimberly loop on legal redlines and confirm DocuSign flow? We’ll need order form language that clearly ties to our MSA (section 5.x of our MSA references service levels).

Thanks — Amit
Amit Shah
Head of Platform — MedAlign Health
amit.shah@medalign.com | +1 212-555-0133

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@medalign.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medalign.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Aug 2028 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: custom uptime & latency annex (order form + MSA/SOW attachments) — MedAlign

Amit —

Thanks — helpful notes. Quick answers and proposed edits (I’ve attached an updated redline that incorporates these points):

1) p99 definition: we’ll commit to p99 measured at Redwood egress (our regional edge) for online inference requests under 1k tokens. We’ll explicitly exclude cold-starts (defined as first request after 60s idle where a new model worker is initialized). We’ll also add a clause to measure client-side latency delta when you instrument the gateway if you want cross-checks.

2) Maintenance windows: we can change scheduled maintenance exclusion to: up to 30 minutes per 30-day period, scheduled only during 00:00–06:00 PT by default, and any maintenance during 08:00–20:00 ET requires 72 hours advance notice and written consent. Emergency maintenance (critical security patches) will still apply with post-facto notice and credit triggers if it impacts availability.

3) Credit cap & escalation: updated to cap credits at 20% of the monthly invoice. We agree to a 2-step escalation before credits: (a) immediate operational remediation window (48 hours) and (b) technical fix remediation period (7 days) before credits trigger. We’ll document the escalation contact list and runbook steps in the evidence package.

4) Evidence & auditing: we’ll include monthly p95/p99 histograms, a 30-day rolling anonymized trace sample for incidents (PII redacted), and read-only dashboard access for MedAlign security. SOC2 Type II attestation will be attached as an exhibit to the SOW.

Attachments in this reply: MedAlign_Redline_OrderForm_20280816.pdf (redline v2), SLA_Addendum_FinalDraft_20280816.docx, evidence-matrix-complete.csv

If that aligns, Kimberly — could you review the redline for legal consistency with our standard order-form language (especially the credit schedule paragraph)? Stephanie — can you confirm the operational runbook items and the telemetry access flow? Ben — SA to review the p99 measurement wording and cold-start exclusion language.

If all good, I’ll prepare the DocuSign envelope and a final SOW exhibit for signature.

Thanks,
Rishi

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 17 Aug 2028 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: custom uptime & latency annex (order form + MSA/SOW attachments) — internal: action items

Team — forwarding the medalign thread. Action items I want tracked before I send the DocuSign: 

- Kimberly: review redline v2 and confirm there are no MSA conflicts; pay attention to the "emergency maintenance" clause and the 20% credit cap language. Reply with any alternate wording by EOD Monday.
- Stephanie: prepare the operational runbook (include alert routing, escalation steps, 24/7 contacts for incident periods, and how read-only telemetry will be provisioned). Attach a runbook PDF.
- Ben: double-check the p99 measurement text and cold-start exclusion wording — ensure it’s not exploitable (e.g., rolling workers to artificially reduce cold-starts). Suggest a minimum warm-worker count or observation window if needed.

I’ve attached the latest redline and the evidence-matrix for you to edit.

Attachments: MedAlign_Redline_OrderForm_20280816.pdf, evidence-matrix-complete.csv

Thanks — I’d like to get this to DocuSign by Wed 08/21 if possible.

-Rishi

Rishi / Kimberly —

Thanks — this looks good and aligns with what procurement and platform engineering asked for. A few small asks before we finalize: 

• Please add a sample incident response timeline to the SOW exhibit (we’d like to see SLA breach handling + sample remediation milestones).
• Confirm that the 30-day anonymized trace sample will be delivered within 5 business days of an incident request.
• Add a single line stating SOC2 Type II report will be provided within 10 business days of signature if requested.

If those three small edits are in, procurement will sign the order form and we’ll circulate the MSA exhibit to Legal. We expect to countersign within 3 business days after DocuSign.
